description:
Goal
Make native codegen boring: it reads published codegen lane facts keyed by ShapeId/ScalarId/CallableId and emits those lanes. It does not derive shape, repr, delivery arity, or continuation result shape locally.

Required changes
Replace DeliveredShape/NativeDemandAbi and codegen surface shape derivation with direct reads from transport/codegen fact tables. Function signatures, continuation entries, closure targets, tail calls, call continuations, mid-flight continuations, and return terms all use the same published lane contracts.

Removal target
DeliveredShape, delivered_shape_from_layout, delivered_shape_from_return_abi for internal flow, continuation_input_shape shape reconstruction, build_codegen_return_repr over body layout, ArgRepr::from_ty/for_block_param_ty use for compiler2 transport lanes, tuple_return_delivery_plan raw-IR rediscovery, collect_codegen_mid_flight_cont_keys deriving shapes from params, and structural mismatch adapters caused by local projections.

Boundary rule
True extern/callable/public boundaries may read boundary fact columns. They still do not mutate the spine or produce an internal delivery shape.

Checks
Native codegen transport tests green; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; rg confirms codegen no longer derives transport reprs from types except for non-compiler2 legacy paths explicitly named and ticketed.
title: Transport spine: make native codegen consume published lane facts only
